problem.action.ha_not_configured: Add-on: restart it. Docker: set the Home Assistant address and a long-lived access token.
problem.action.ha_disconnected: Check that Home Assistant is running and that the access token is still valid.
problem.action.no_energy_dashboard: Declare your solar production and your meter there (Settings › Dashboards › Energy).
problem.action.home_not_saved: Check the proposed devices and save your home.
problem.action.no_forecast: Add a forecast to the Home Assistant Energy dashboard, or describe your panels.
problem.action.sensor_missing: Replace it in My home, or re-read Home Assistant if the device was renamed.
problem.action.sensor_unavailable: Check the device or its integration in Home Assistant.
problem.action.sensor_silent: Check that the device is on and connected.
problem.action.internal_error: If the error persists, attach the report below to a bug report.
problem.action.writes_behind: If it lasts, attach the report to a bug report.
problem.action.disk_low: Free up space on this disk; as a Home Assistant app, you can also shorten how long readings are kept in its options.
problem.action.backup_space: Free up space on this disk before the next backup.
problem.action.memory_high: If it lasts, restart the application and attach the report to a bug report.
problem.action.memory_heavy: If it lasts, restart the application and attach the report to a bug report.
problem.action.plan_slow: If it lasts, attach the report to a bug report.
problem.action.no_statistics: These sensors have no statistics in Home Assistant: the plan does not start from their history.
problem.action.plan_stale: Look at the other problems, or run a computation from the home page.
problem.action.configuration_issue: Fix the setting in My home.
problem.action.impossible_data: Check the history of this sensor in Home Assistant at that time.
problem.action.impossible_data_unknown: A meter jump probably distorts the base consumption: check the history of your energy meters in Home Assistant.
problem.issue.entity_missing: {entity} does not exist in Home Assistant.
problem.issue.not_energy_unit: {entity} is not an energy meter (unit: "{unit}"): remove it from the Energy dashboard or replace it.
problem.issue.unexpected_device_class: {entity} is declared as "{device_class}" in Home Assistant, which is not an energy meter.
problem.issue.no_power_sensor: No power found for {entity}: it is used to recognize the device's cycles.
problem.issue.battery_capacity_missing: Unknown battery capacity: please enter it.
problem.issue.battery_soc_missing: Battery charge level missing from the Energy dashboard.
problem.issue.not_proposed: Saved device no longer present in the Energy dashboard.
problem.issue.name_suggests_cost: {entity} looks like a cost (from its name), not consumed energy: it is not kept by default. Check it again if it really is a meter.
problem.configuration_issue.unknown_devi: {device}: not a device of the saved home.
problem.configuration_issue.behavior_not: {device}: this behavior is not possible for this kind of device.
problem.configuration_issue.observed_aut: {device}: a device that is only tracked can only be displayed, not recommended.
problem.configuration_issue.automation_n: {device}: confirmation and automatic control will come in a later version.
problem.configuration_issue.bands_not_us: Tariff: this kind of tariff uses no bands.
problem.configuration_issue.band_empty: Tariff: band {band} is empty (end before start).
problem.configuration_issue.holiday_coun: Tariff: unknown country or region for public holidays; holidays count as ordinary days.
problem.configuration_issue.tariff_witho: Tariff: the day color sensor is missing.
problem.configuration_issue.color_twice: Tariff: a color is declared twice.
problem.configuration_issue.tariff_witho: Tariff: the price sensor is missing.
problem.configuration_issue.battery_acti: Battery: the operating time range is empty.
problem.configuration_issue.panels_not_u: {device}: solar panels can only be described on a solar installation.
problem.configuration_issue.runtime_spee: {device}: each speed needs a different name (and not “off”).
problem.configuration_issue.need_not_use: {device}: energy need set for another behavior.
problem.configuration_issue.need_window_: {device}: the deadline must come after the earliest hour.
problem.configuration_issue.need_too_lar: {device}: too much energy for {hours} h at the maximum power.
problem.configuration_issue.constraints_: {device}: time constraints for a device the planner does not schedule.
{device}: the strict constraints forbid the whole day.
problem.configuration_issue.after_not_us: {device}: “starts after” set for a device that is not a cycle.
problem.configuration_issue.after_unknow: {device}: the device to follow ({after}) is not in the home.
problem.configuration_issue.delay_not_us: {device}: postponement tolerance set for a device that is not a cycle.
problem.configuration_issue.battery_floo: Battery: a floor range is empty ({range}).
problem.configuration_issue.recurrence_n: {device}: recurrence set for a device that is not a cycle.
problem.configuration_issue.objective_we: Objective: weights given for a preset that does not use them.

problem.configuration_issue.objective_co: Objective: CO₂ needs a grid carbon intensity sensor.
problem.configuration_issue.import_forma: This file is not an WattSlot home export.
problem.connection_error.starting: Home Assistant has restarted and is not ready yet; the application keeps trying by itself.
problem.connection_error.unreachable: Home Assistant does not answer at the given address: check that it is running and that the address is correct.
problem.connection_error.token_refused: Home Assistant refuses the access token: connect the application again (or check the token in the .env file if the connection is set there).
problem.connection_error.unknown: The connection to Home Assistant failed.
problem.configuration_issue.battery_not_: {device}: battery settings on a device that is not a battery.
